changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant output descriptions and normalized model capitalization. The paper clearly addresses NLG through question answering with generated textual responses.
Normalized 'Rouge-L' to 'ROUGE' following simplification guidelines. All metrics are correctly identified.
Normalized model name formatting. The paper explicitly uses LLMs as judges to assess correctness and consistency of generated answers.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. Only automatic metrics and LLM-as-judge evaluations are used.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) which involves natural language generation of answers. It uses both traditional automatic metrics (ROUGE) and LLM-as-judge evaluations (QwenScore, LlamaScore) to assess the quality of generated responses. The extraction was generally accurate with minor normalization needed.
